faces.name: Seize the Spotlight
faces.oracle_text: Each opponent chooses fame or fortune. For each player who chose fame, gain control of a creature that player controls until end of turn. Untap those creatures and they gain haste until end of turn. For each player who chose fortune, you draw a card and create a Treasure token.

Untap those creatures and they gain haste until end of turn. For each player who chose fortune, you draw a card and create a Treasure token.
